title: Sardinian Rocket Panforte
description: A salty and tender Sardinian dish featuring rocket, served in a bamboo tray, perfect for a brunch mood. This halal-friendly panforte is made with stone-bowl-dolsot cooked ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the stone-bowl-dolsot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the rocket leaves to the bowl and toss to coat with the dressing.
Transfer the rocket mixture to the preheated stone-bowl-dolsot and cook for 10 minutes.
While the rocket is cooking, prepare the bamboo tray by lining it with parchment paper.
Remove the rocket from the stone-bowl-dolsot and transfer it to the bamboo tray.
Top the rocket with shaved Grana padano cheese and chopped pistachios.
Serve the Sardinian Rocket Panforte hot, straight from the bamboo tray.
